meta.title: Vendor removed from Technical Stage is blocked from quoting in the RFQ commercial stage
gaps: Create or verify the prerequisite that Vendor A was explicitly removed from or failed the Technical Stage before attempting the RFQ quote.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Create or verify the prerequisite that Vendor A was explicitly removed from or failed the Technical Stage before attempting the RFQ quote.

steps.note: Open the prepared eRFX event's Technical Stage before switching to the vendor session.
Act as the invited vendor in the supplier portal.
Attempt to open the commercial RFQ bid submission screen; this should expose the technical-stage access gate if enforced.
Attempt to submit a commercial quotation and require the vendor portal to refuse it.
